item.title: Seoul's worst China tech fears are coming true
item.description: Samsung and SK Hynix memory chips account for much of the country's $700 bln in exports. As the duo reap AI windfalls, $430 bln CXMT is capitalizing on shortages of less advanced products. Momentum gives the Hefei-based challenger scope to leapfrog incumbents for whatever's next.
item.dc:creator: Robyn Mak
item.content:encoded: Memory chips are inducing headaches in Seoul. SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won recently warned that Chinese challengers were an imminent threat to South Korea's technological dominance in semiconductors. Recent developments suggest that the neighbouring competition is quickly becoming an acute danger. It is difficult to understate the industry's importance to South Korea's $2.6 trillion economy. Semiconductors, mostly those used to store and transmit information, accounted for a whopping 40% of the country's $700 billion of exports in the eight months through August. Voracious demand from data-hungry AI models amplifies the dependence. At a combined $1.7 trillion, Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) represent roughly half of the benchmark KOSPI index (.KS11) by market capitalization. Flush with machine-learning profit, South Korea is racing to capitalize on what the government calls a "once-in-a thousand-years opportunity." In June, President Lee Jae Myung [USN:L4N43005G TEXT:"unveiled"] a nearly $600 billion investment initiative to cement the country's leading position. The imminent risk isn't necessarily that fast-growing Chinese companies, such as CXMT (688825.SS) and Yangtze Memory Technologies, which are taking advantage of shortages in less advanced products, will catch up to the latest generation of memory chips. Rather, it is that they will use all the capital and clout they are accumulating to leapfrog the industry and dominate what's next. It's a strategy that Chinese policymakers call "overtaking by changing lanes." The country's automakers, for example, achieved the feat by revving past combustion engines to become the international leaders in electric vehicles. Unseating Samsung and SK would be a Herculean task. The duo accounted for more than 60% of the market by revenue for dynamic random-access memory, or DRAM, which is used for conventional data storage in everything from PCs to smartphones and data centers. They also claim more than 80% of the market for high-bandwidth memory, or the vertically stacked DRAM essential in producing cutting-edge AI chips from Nvidia (NVDA.O) , AMD (AMD.O) and others. Only Samsung, SK and US-based Micron (MU.O) can manufacture HBM at scale today. There are other impediments to Chinese companies. They are hobbled by US-backed restrictions on sophisticated chipmaking equipment, particularly in extreme ultraviolet lithography tools. Those have largely confined state-backed CXMT and Yangtze to the more commoditised end of the memory market. Despite such constraints, they are just two years behind the market leaders in DRAM and three years behind in HBM, the Korea Semiconductor Industry Association estimates . In another type of memory known as flash, the gap is just one year. Beijing's longstanding support includes direct subsidies, cheap financing, tax breaks and policy that incentivises local businesses to buy from domestic chipmakers. More recently, China's homegrown tech champions have incumbents and the AI boom to thank as well: SK, Samsung and Micron are all diverting more capacity to make high-bandwidth memory, resulting in a painful shortage of non-AI memory for everyone from iPhone-maker Apple to its Chinese competitor Xiaomi. These shifts have created a [USN:L6N4340I8 TEXT:"rare opening"] for China's top DRAM maker, CXMT, whose market value exceeds $430 billion. Its conventional memory products may be a few years behind, but their performance is good enough to compete. And demand probably won't be limited to domestic customers only. Apple, Dell and HP are considering using Chinese memory chips in devices sold outside the United States, according to [USN:FWN446032 TEXT:"media "][USN:L4N3Z10FN TEXT:"reports"], putting CXMT head-to-head against the Big Three in export markets. The trio are doubling down on high-bandwidth memory and willingly ceding the less-sophisticated part of the market to CXMT. As a result, it's helping to ensure the company's long-term competitiveness. It's on track to generate an operating profit of 643 billion yuan ($96.4 billion) next year, up from just 8 billion yuan in 2025, according to estimates from Bernstein analysts. The money will help fund aggressive capacity expansion, with cumulative capital expenditure projected to top $68 billion over the next three years. Those figures pale in comparison to Samsung and SK, which are also planning aggressive long-term expansion plans. Even so, CXMT's overall DRAM market share by shipments is expected to reach 11% in 2028, up from 8% last year, per research firm Counterpoint. The growth is critical because in such a capital-intensive and highly cyclical industry, nothing matters more than size. Memory makers need to secure at least 15% of the market to stay viable, Counterpoint analysts reckon . They expect CXMT to cross that threshold in less than a decade, effectively turning the memory oligopoly into a foursome. At least for Chey, SK's chairman, and Jay Y. Lee, Samsung's de facto boss, the geopolitical and technological rivalries between Beijing and Washington should ensure South Korea's dominance in AI supply chains. It would be unthinkable, for instance, that hyperscalers such as Amazon.com (AMZN.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) and Meta Platforms (META.O) would fill American data centres with made-in-China chips. US officials may yet tighten export controls, potentially setting Chinese chipmakers back; CXMT also risks joining compatriots Huawei and YMTC on the so-called "entity list" that blocks access to US tech and software. Constraints can inspire creativity, however. Huawei, the country's answer to Nvidia, has been forced to explore alternative approaches because of US sanctions and export controls. It recently unveiled a novel chip design and manufacturing method called the Tau Scaling Law, which it presents as a successor to Moore's Law. In memory, CXMT and its peers are pursuing a similar strategy with developments such as bonded DRAM technology to produce faster, more efficient chips without relying on extreme ultraviolet lithography machines. Samsung and SK are eyeing breakthroughs, too, but they have already committed billions of dollars to existing technology roadmaps. It presents the South Korean conglomerates with a classic innovator's dilemma, where mighty incumbents are slow to embrace new developments that may undermine financial returns for their established businesses. The gradual rise of CXMT and compatriots will have far-reaching implications beyond Seoul. Just as with other industries where Chinese manufacturers have conquered, including solar panels, smaller and weaker competitors will be squeezed out. That puts Japan's Kioxia (285A.T) and Micron, among others, in a vulnerable position. Moreover, Chinese semiconductor advances will give Beijing considerable trade and technological leverage, alongside rare earths. South Korea's chip angst may soon spread across world. Follow Robyn Mak on X .

item.title: Pesquisas de boca de urna em Israel apontam impasse, em aparente revés para Netanyahu
item.description: As eleições em tempo de guerra em Israel ficaram empatadas na terça-feira, segundo mostraram as pesquisas de boca de urna: duas grandes redes de televisão atribuíram ao bloco da oposição liderado por Gadi Eisenkot uma vantagem estreita sobre o grupo do primeiro-ministro Benjamin Netanyahu, enquanto uma terceira indicou empate, deixando nenhum dos lados com um caminho claro para o poder.
item.dc:creator: Maayan Lubell, Lili Bayer, Tamar Beeri
item.content:encoded: As eleições em tempo de guerra em Israel ficaram empatadas na terça-feira, segundo mostraram as pesquisas de boca de urna: duas grandes redes de televisão atribuíram ao bloco da oposição liderado por Gadi Eisenkot uma vantagem estreita sobre o grupo do primeiro-ministro Benjamin Netanyahu, enquanto uma terceira indicou empate, deixando nenhum dos lados com um caminho claro para o poder. Se as projeções se confirmarem, o resultado representaria um grande revés para a coalizão de Netanyahu, que entrou na eleição com 68 cadeiras, embora o impasse possa permitir que o primeiro-ministro mais antigo de Israel permaneça no poder como interino durante as negociações de coalizão. A participação eleitoral foi de 77,7%, informou a Comissão Eleitoral Central de Israel, a maior em mais de duas décadas e cerca de 7 pontos percentuais acima da registrada em 2022. Duas das três principais redes de televisão de Israel atribuíram ao bloco de Eisenkot uma vantagem estreita sobre o campo liderado pelo Likud, de Netanyahu, em pesquisas de boca de urna atualizadas, enquanto o Canal 13 colocou os dois blocos empatados com 51 cadeiras cada. Nenhuma das projeções atribuiu a nenhum dos blocos os 61 assentos necessários para a maioria no Knesset, que conta com 120 assentos. Os partidos religiosos de extrema-direita liderados por Itamar Ben-Gvir e Bezalel Smotrich deveriam conquistar, juntos, 13 assentos dentro do bloco de Netanyahu. Os partidos árabes fora dos dois principais blocos poderiam resolver o impasse. Mas Eisenkot, líder do partido Yashar e ex-chefe militar, praticamente descartou a formação de um governo com eles, complicando seu caminho para o poder mesmo nas projeções em que seu bloco termina na liderança. Os resultados finais podem demorar dias, e o sistema político fragmentado de Israel torna os partidos menores potenciais decisores. Nenhum partido isolado jamais conquistou 61 cadeiras por si só no Knesset, de 120 cadeiras, tornando as coalizões a regra. Essa foi a primeira eleição desde os ataques liderados pelo Hamas em 7 de outubro de 2023 e as guerras que se seguiram em Gaza, no Líbano e no Irã. Yohanan Plesner, presidente do Instituto para a Democracia de Israel, considerou as pesquisas de boca de urna uma grande derrota para a coalizão de Netanyahu, que, segundo elas, cairia de 68 cadeiras no Knesset atual para cerca de 50. Mas ele afirmou que Eisenkot não havia se destacado como um vencedor claro. REVÉS DE NETANYAHU, SEM VENCEDOR CLARO Embora não houvesse um resultado claro, as pesquisas de boca de urna refletiram a força da oposição anti-Netanyahu. O líder da oposição Yair Lapid disse em um comunicado: “Não deixem ninguém confundir vocês: o bloco de Netanyahu sofreu uma derrota esmagadora. Trata-se de um colapso total, e o público mandou que eles fossem para casa.” Eisenkot, de 66 anos, um ex-chefe militar de linha dura que perdeu um filho e dois sobrinhos na guerra de Gaza, emergiu como o adversário mais forte de Netanyahu, enfatizando suas credenciais em segurança enquanto se posicionava como um político de centro no cenário interno. Ele entrou na política há apenas quatro anos e integrou o gabinete de guerra de Netanyahu após o ataque do Hamas em 2023, mas se demitiu oito meses depois, criticando a liderança do primeiro-ministro. Eisenkot propõe uma ruptura com a liderança de Netanyahu e seus aliados de extrema-direita, mas não com a abordagem linha-dura em relação à segurança, que se tornou mais arraigada desde o ataque do Hamas em 2023: ele se opõe à criação de um Estado palestino e afirma que a ala militar do Hamas deve ser destruída ou desmantelada. Eisenkot afirma que a resposta de Israel — uma guerra que matou mais de 74 mil palestinos, segundo as autoridades de saúde de Gaza — foi um fracasso, pois o Hamas continua no poder. “Caros democratas, uma decisão foi tomada”, disse Yair Golan, líder do Partido Democrata e rival de Netanyahu, em um comício do partido após o encerramento da votação. “A nação nos confiou um dever sagrado: transformar em ação a confiança que depositaram em nós, fortalecer a democracia, salvar Israel e garantir uma verdadeira defesa para o Estado.” A sede da Lista Conjunta, uma aliança de vários partidos árabes, explodiu em assobios e aplausos quando as pesquisas de boca de urna foram divulgadas ao encerramento da votação, em uma noite histórica para a participação eleitoral entre os cidadãos palestinos de Israel. “Rejeitamos a ocupação e o racismo, e permaneceremos aqui”, disse Faten Gattas, candidata da Lista Conjunta, em um discurso na sede da aliança em Nazaré. Os candidatos esperavam que a alta participação eleitoral árabe lhes permitisse desempenhar um papel decisivo para impedir que a coalizão de Netanyahu – a mais de extrema-direita da história de Israel – voltasse ao poder. PARTICIPAÇÃO RECORDE Longas filas se formaram do lado de fora das seções eleitorais à medida que os eleitores compareciam em grande número, lidando com o trauma do dia mais sangrento de Israel, quando o Hamas matou 1.200 pessoas e fez 251 reféns, e com as guerras em Gaza e contra o Hezbollah do Líbano e o Irã que se seguiram. Embora Netanyahu tenha sido criticado pela maior falha de segurança do país, ele argumentou que tornou Israel e o mundo mais seguros ao assassinar os principais líderes do Hamas, do Hezbollah e do Irã. As políticas da coalizão de direita de Netanyahu têm gerado divisões no país e aprofundado o isolamento internacional de Israel, mas ele se apresenta como o líder com coragem para enfrentar os inimigos de Israel. Netanyahu, de 77 anos, ocupou o cargo de primeiro-ministro por quase 19 dos últimos 30 anos e sobreviveu repetidamente a crises políticas. Seus oponentes conseguiram tirar-lhe o cargo de primeiro-ministro apenas uma vez desde 2009, após quatro eleições sem resultado conclusivo em dois anos. Dezoito meses depois, ele estava de volta. Ele entrou na disputa eleitoral enfrentando acusações de corrupção de longa data, que ele nega, e críticas sobre falhas dos serviços de inteligência que permitiram que militantes liderados pelo Hamas realizassem seu ataque. Netanyahu fez campanha com o apoio do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, seu aliado na guerra contra o Irã.

item.title: Lula diz que viagem de Flávio para os EUA após derrota na eleição é ato vergonhoso
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva classificou nesta terça-feira como um "ato vergonhoso" o fato de seu adversário no segundo turno da disputa presidencial, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro, ter saído do país rumo aos Estados Unidos após ser derrotado na eleição de domingo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva classificou nesta terça-feira como um "ato vergonhoso" o fato de seu adversário no segundo turno da disputa presidencial, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro, ter saído do país rumo aos Estados Unidos após ser derrotado na eleição de domingo. Lula afirmou, em discurso a apoiadores por ocasião de seu aniversário de 81 anos nesta terça, que "quem não deve, não teme", e argumentou que o senador deve ter culpa na consciência para ter decidido deixar o país após a derrota eleitoral. Flávio deixou o país com destino aos Estados Unidos, disseram à Reuters uma fonte do governo dos EUA e um aliado próximo do parlamentar. Ele descumpriu prazo estabelecido pelo ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), para entregar seus passaportes à Polícia Federal na manhã desta terça-feira. O senador é alvo de inquéritos no STF, incluindo um que apura suspeita de lavagem de dinheiro envolvendo o advogado e amigo do parlamentar Willer Tomaz. Ambos negam qualquer irregularidade.

item.title: US health chief RFK Jr faces widespread rebuke over his anti-Arab remarks
item.description: US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. faced widespread rebuke from civil rights groups, healthcare advocates and Democrats on Tuesday over his anti-Arab comments that the Council on American-Islamic Relations cast as "a textbook display of unvarnished racism and bigotry."
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. faced widespread rebuke from civil rights groups, healthcare advocates and Democrats on Tuesday over his anti-Arab comments that the Council on American-Islamic Relations cast as "a textbook display of unvarnished racism and bigotry." In his remarks on Monday at a campaign event in Michigan where Republican Mike Rogers is running for the US Senate against Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, the US health secretary falsely claimed that Arabs had not won major international awards and "don't produce" science and literature. "There's 500 million Arabs in the world, and yet they don't produce science, they don't win the Nobel Prize, they don't win the Fields prize, they don't win the Wolf Prize, they don't produce literature," the US health chief said. Arabs have won all those prizes. Peter Hotez, who is a professor at the Baylor College of Medicine and specializes in vaccine development and tropical medicine, said his late colleague, Nobel Prize winner Ahmed Zewail, who was Arab and died in 2016, "would disagree" with the US health chief's comments. The Department of Health and Human Services did not immediately respond to a request for comment. US rights advocates have raised concerns over [USN:L1N45U12W TEXT:"escalating rhetoric"] against Muslims, Arabs, immigrants and ethnic minorities [USN:L1N4620ZA TEXT:"by"] President Donald Trump and his allies during the ongoing midterm election campaign . "Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s vile anti-Arab rant is a textbook display of unvarnished racism and bigotry," the Council on American-Islamic Relations, which documents hate against Muslims and Arabs in the US, said on Tuesday. "His sweeping erasure of Arab contributions to humanity is not only maliciously false, but it also fans the flames of anti-Arab and anti-Muslim hate at a time when communities are already vulnerable to bigoted attacks from other public officials nationwide." Kennedy said the rise of the Muslim Brotherhood, one of the Arab world's oldest and most influential Islamist groups founded almost a century ago, has "created stagnant societies." Republicans have claimed, without evidence, El-Sayed has ties to the Muslim Brotherhood even as the Democrat has [USN:L6N4661FE TEXT:"publicly disavowed"] the group and denied any connection to it. El-Sayed, who is Muslim, has faced a host of anti-Muslim attacks during the campaign. Over the weekend, Trump [USN:L1N469003 TEXT:"invoked"] the September 11, 2001, attacks when speaking about El-Sayed, whom he has also repeatedly and [USN:L6N4661FE TEXT:"falsely called"] a "jihadist." Democratic US Senator Chris Murphy also responded to the US health secretary's comments. "I really think everyone needs to pay attention to this coordinated campaign to delegitimize Muslim Americans — not just as citizens but as humans." US healthcare advocacy organization and nonprofit Protect Our Care cast Kennedy's comments as a "wildly racist tirade." Kennedy, who has pushed his anti-vaccine views in his role as the top health official, was also in Michigan on Monday to promote funding for Detroit's health department and touted agreements with hospitals to offer healthier food.

item.title: FTC says New York's 'shield law' is interfering with US transgender care probe
item.description: The US Federal Trade Commission on Tuesday said the New York Attorney General's Office is blocking one of the state's largest hospital networks from complying with a subpoena in a federal investigation involving gender-affirming care for transgender children.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Wiessner
item.content:encoded: The US Federal Trade Commission on Tuesday said the New York Attorney General's Office is blocking one of the state's largest hospital networks from complying with a subpoena in a federal investigation involving gender-affirming care for transgender children. The filing in Manhattan federal court involving Mount Sinai Hospitals Group sets up [USN:L1N45O0KX TEXT:"another showdown over laws"] passed by many Democratic-led states shielding healthcare providers from out-of-state legal action involving abortion or transgender care. The FTC said Mount Sinai, which it called "an innocent party," agreed last month to comply with the subpoena related to [USN:L6N42O1FE TEXT:"the agency's lawsuit"] against the World Professional Association for Transgender Health (WPATH). The nonprofit is accused of making misleading statements about the benefits of gender-affirming treatment, which it denies. But the office of New York Attorney General Letitia James, a Democrat, told Mount Sinai "out of the blue" that under [USN:L1N3OU1C6 TEXT:"the state's 2023 shield law"], it was required to wait at least 30 days to respond to the subpoena and obtain an affidavit from the FTC stating that it would not take any legal action against the hospital operator. The FTC, which enforces antitrust and consumer protection laws, said on Tuesday that both of those requirements clash with federal law and are preempted, and moved to enforce its subpoena. The agency said it was legally bound to file the petition in New York, where Mount Sinai operates. But it asked US District Judge Katherine Polk Failla to transfer the case to the Fort Worth, Texas, federal court where it sued WPATH. Mount Sinai did not immediately respond to a request for comment. James' office declined to comment. The commission has subpoenaed at least seven other hospital networks across the country in the case against WPATH, which is part of broader efforts by President Donald Trump's administration to curtail access to gender-affirming care. That has included investigating some of the country's largest healthcare systems that provide gender-affirming treatment such as puberty blockers, hormone therapy and surgical procedures to minors. Mount Sinai and several other hospital systems have agreed to stop providing those treatments and dedicate millions of dollars to helping patients reverse the procedures to settle federal probes. Last month, two major hospital systems [USN:L1N45A11W TEXT:"agreed to pay $9.5 million"] to settle the US Department of Justice's claims that they improperly billed Medicaid for gender-affirming care provided to minors. The case is FTC v. Mount Sinai Hospitals Group, US District Court for the Southern District of New York, No. 1:26-mc-00532. item.title: Ganancias de unidad de Walmart en México disminuyen a pesar del crecimiento en ventas
item.description: Las ganancias de la filial de Walmart en México, Walmex, quedaron abajo de las previsiones para el tercer trimestre, ya que el aumento de los costos e inversiones mermaron los márgenes, lo que eclipsó el crecimiento de dos dígitos del comercio electrónico.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las ganancias de la filial de Walmart en México, Walmex, quedaron abajo de las previsiones para el tercer trimestre, ya que el aumento de los costos e inversiones mermaron los márgenes, lo que eclipsó el crecimiento de dos dígitos del comercio electrónico. La utilidad neta cayó un 6%, a 11,030 millones de pesos (unos 610 millones de dólares), por debajo de los 12,260 millones de pesos que esperaban los analistas encuestados por LSEG, mientras que los ingresos también se quedaron por debajo de las previsiones. El mayor minorista de México registró ingresos totales de 248,830 millones de pesos en el periodo comprendido entre julio y septiembre, un 3% más que el mismo lapso del año anterior, pero por debajo de los 250, 440 millones de pesos previstos por analistas. Las utilidades antes de intereses, impuestos, depreciación y amortización (EBITDA) aumentaron solo un 0.4%, a 25,370 millones de pesos, mientras que el margen EBITDA se redujo en 30 puntos básicos al 10.2%. La presión sobre los márgenes se debió a que los gastos generales aumentaron casi un 6% con respecto al mismo trimestre del año anterior, mientras que los gastos de ventas también subieron más de un 6% debido al crecimiento en inversiones. Las ventas en tiendas comparables aumentaron casi un 2% en México, donde el valor medio creció un 1.6% y la afluencia de clientes se mantuvo prácticamente estable. El comercio electrónico siguió siendo un punto fuerte, con un aumento del valor bruto de la mercancía en línea del 15% en México y del 23% en Centroamérica. (1 dólar = 18.0808 pesos a finales de septiembre)

item.title: Cyclone Arnab begins making landfall in India's Andhra Pradesh state
item.description: A severe cyclone started making landfall in India's Andhra Pradesh state in the early hours of Wednesday, bringing high-speed winds and heavy rain that uprooted trees and disrupted power supply, authorities said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A severe cyclone started making landfall in India's Andhra Pradesh state in the early hours of Wednesday, bringing high-speed winds and heavy rain that uprooted trees and disrupted power supply, authorities said. Thousands of people were [USN:L6N46D0NN TEXT:"evacuated"] along India's eastern coast this week and some train and flight services were canceled ahead of Cyclone Arnab's arrival. The India Meteorological Department said wind speed over the landfall area was forecast at 125-135 kilometers/hour (78-84 mph), gusting to 150 kph, over the next four hours before decreasing gradually. A storm surge of 1.5 to 2.5 metres (about 5-8 feet) above normal tide was very likely to inundate low-lying areas of Andhra Pradesh over the next six hours, the IMD said. No loss of life had been reported so far, although trees were uprooted in several places and power supply was disrupted, the office of Andhra Pradesh's chief minister said. Arnab is sweeping in from the Bay of Bengal, a major region for tropical cyclones that has spawned deadly storms on India's east coast. A super cyclone that killed nearly 10,000 people when it hit Odisha in October 1999 remains one of the country's deadliest natural disasters.

item.title: Jerry Jones: 'Very possible' Cowboys could hire Troy Aikman
item.description: Dallas owner Jerry Jones said in a radio interview Tuesday it's "very possible" he could hire ESPN broadcaster and former Cowboy Troy Aikman for a role in the organization.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dallas owner Jerry Jones said in a radio interview Tuesday it's "very possible" he could hire ESPN broadcaster and former Cowboy Troy Aikman for a role in the organization. "And the answer is ... not that necessarily we're going to do something more direct with the team at this time," Jones told Dallas radio station 105.3 The Fan on Tuesday. "But don't rule it out. It's very possible." Jones' comments come a day after the two had an approximately 10-minute conversation on the field at Lincoln Financial Field before the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the host Philadelphia Eagles. The conversation happened after the longtime "Monday Night Football" announcer said in a recent radio interview that he is looking for his "next landing spot" with his ESPN contract set to expire after February's Super Bowl. "I'll broadcast through this season, and I'll be a free agent at the end of the year and kind of see what happens," Aikman, 59, told KTCK of Dallas on Oct. 15. Aikman, a Hall of Fame quarterback who won three Super Bowls with the Dallas Cowboys, is in the final year of a five-year deal with ESPN that pays him $18 million annually. When asked by 105.3 The Fan if the Cowboys would hire Aikman for a role with the franchise, Jones said, "Yeah. Yes, I could and would. And so it's that simple because I do think that much of him, with his basic command and understanding and knowledge of NFL football. And so he certainly is qualified to do any of the things that have been mentioned. And I think he's outstanding at what he focuses on right now, and that's giving the story, the narration of the football games of all teams." Aikman told the website Cowboys Roundtable on Friday that he realizes his broadcasting career "could very well be taken away from me" and that he would consider a role with the Cowboys should Jones offer one. "I would welcome any conversation with Jerry," Aikman said. "And quite honestly I don't know if there would be or if there ever would be an opportunity. But if Jerry came to me and felt that, in his heart, I could lend some services that would help make them better, I would. I'd have a hard time not taking a good look at that." Aikman's comments about his future come amid reported tension between him and broadcast partner for the past 25 years, Joe Buck, over their respective contract situations. Buck reportedly finalized a six-year extension with ESPN in September worth more than $100 million. The pair reportedly had an argument before the Oct. 12 game between the Buffalo Bills and Los Angeles Rams at SoFi Stadium, site of Super Bowl LXI on Feb. 14, which Aikman acknowledged to KTCK of Dallas but did not discuss details of. "There's probably a time and a place for all that to be discussed," Aikman told KTCK of Dallas. "I don't know if now is the time. I don't know that it's hard to figure out kind of what's happened." --Field Level Media

item.title: Jordan, Syria to form security committee after deadly strikes on Islamic State sites
item.description: Jordan and Syria have agreed to form a joint security committee to examine the details and repercussions of recent Jordanian airstrikes against Islamic State sites in Syria, the two countries' foreign ministries said in a joint statement early on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jordan and Syria have agreed to form a joint security committee to examine the details and repercussions of recent Jordanian airstrikes against Islamic State sites in Syria, the two countries' foreign ministries said in a joint statement early on Wednesday. Jordanian Foreign Minister Ayman Safadi told his Syrian counterpart Asaad al-Shaibani that Tuesday's strikes were based on field intelligence and aimed at "neutralising" confirmed threats and imminent attacks targeting Jordan's security, while expressinh "deep regret" over civilian deaths during the operations.

item.title: Former DOGE staffer Jeremy Lewin departs US State Department policy role
item.description: The US State Department's policy chief, Jeremy Lewin, said on Tuesday he was leaving his role after nearly two years in which he helped lead an overhaul of US foreign assistance and implemented President Donald Trump's policies toward Venezuela and Cuba.
item.dc:creator: Simon Lewis
item.content:encoded: The US State Department's policy chief, Jeremy Lewin, said on Tuesday he was leaving his role after nearly two years in which he helped lead an overhaul of US foreign assistance and implemented President Donald Trump's policies toward Venezuela and Cuba. Lewin, a top adviser to Secretary of State Marco Rubio, said on social media he was leaving to return to the private sector. "President Trump has put decades of post-Cold War malaise behind us — permanently transforming US foreign policy to put Americans first, keep them safe, and drive peace and shared prosperity in key regions," Lewin said on X. The 29-year-old joined the government as part of Elon Musk's Department of Government Efficiency and played a leading role in closing the US Agency for International Development. Trump and Musk justified the move by accusing the agency of waste, fraud and abuse. Some programs were later restored or revamped under the State Department. Lewin oversaw that process as acting under secretary of state for foreign assistance, humanitarian affairs and religious freedom. In late August, Lewin began his stint as the department's director of policy planning, in which he focused on US policy toward Venezuela and Cuba, according to his State Department biography. The biography says Lewin is the only person under 30 to serve in the policy planning role. The US military captured Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro in January. Washington has since controlled the sale of Venezuelan oil and holds the proceeds, and Trump has said no Venezuelan oil will go to Cuba. That move cut off the main source of oil for Communist-run Cuba.

item.title: Walmart's margins in Mexico tighten as costs outpace sales growth
item.description: Walmart's Mexico unit missed third-quarter profit estimates on Tuesday as rising costs and investments ate into margins, overshadowing double-digit e-commerce growth.
item.dc:creator: Kylie Madry, Natalia Siniawski
item.content:encoded: Walmart's Mexico unit (WALMEX.MX) missed third-quarter profit estimates on Tuesday as rising costs and investments ate into margins, overshadowing double-digit e-commerce growth. Net profit fell 6% to 11.03 billion pesos ($610 million), below the 12.26 billion pesos expected by analysts polled by LSEG, while revenue also came in shy of forecasts. Mexico's biggest retailer posted total revenue of 248.83 billion pesos for the July-September period, up 3% from a year earlier but below the 250.44 billion pesos expected by analysts Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization rose just 0.4% to 25.37 billion pesos, while EBITDA margin narrowed 30 basis points to 10.2% The profit pressure came as expenses continued to rise faster than sales; Chief Financial Officer Camilo Canedo attributed the increased spending to investments in new stores, e-commerce, technology and staffing Walmex reaffirmed its 2026 guidance, forecasting consolidated sales growth of 3.5% to 4.5% in constant currency and an EBITDA margin slightly below last year's level of 10.2% Same-store sales rose almost 2% in Mexico, where ticket growth was 1.6% and traffic was broadly flat E-commerce remained a bright spot, with online gross merchandise value (GMV) up 15% in Mexico and 23% in Central America Canedo said 75% of online orders were delivered the same day, up 1,500 basis points from a year earlier, while nearly 30% were delivered in under two hours and close to 10% in less than one hour ($1 = 18.0808 pesos at end-September)

item.title: Cooper Companies CEO White steps down
item.description: Cooper Companies said on Tuesday CEO Al White had stepped down, effective immediately, and board member Walt Rosebrough was elected executive chair as the medical device maker begins its search for a new CEO.
item.dc:creator: Siddhi Mahatole
item.content:encoded: Cooper Companies (COO.O) said on Tuesday CEO Al White had stepped down, effective immediately, and board member Walt Rosebrough was elected executive chair as the medical device maker begins its search for a new CEO. Rosebrough, an independent director who joined the board in January, is the former CEO of STERIS (STE.N) and will oversee day-to-day operations at Cooper until a permanent CEO is appointed Rosebrough said recent performance "has not met our expectations" and warranted decisive action by the board The leadership overhaul was not a surprise given the involvement of [USN:L4N45A0YS TEXT:"activist investors Jana"] and Browning West, and could mark an early step toward improving shareholder value, J.P. Morgan analyst Robbie Marcus said Cooper's review of strategic options for its women's health business did not result in a sale, contributing to pressure on management, Marcus said A new management team does not guarantee better returns, but the changes could help restore investor trust, he added White, who is also leaving the board, will remain with the company as a strategic adviser through April 2027 Additionally, Shlomi Nachman, a former Johnson & Johnson (JNJ.N) executive with experience in medical devices and vision care, will join the board as an independent director, from December 8, Cooper said Three current board members, Barbara Carbone, Colleen Jay and Robert Weiss, will not stand for re-election at the company's 2027 annual shareholder meeting, it added The company reaffirmed its fiscal 2026 forecast issued on [USN:L4N4511U9 TEXT:"September 9"], including annual adjusted earnings of $4.51 to $4.55 per share

item.title: Understrength Al-Hilal slip to first defeat in Asian Champions League
item.description: Qatar's Al-Shamal claimed a 3-1 win over Al-Hilal at Al-Bayt Stadium on Tuesday to hand the understrength Saudi Pro League leaders their first loss in the western league phase of the Asian Champions League Elite.
item.dc:creator: Michael Church
item.content:encoded: Qatar's Al-Shamal claimed a 3-1 win over Al-Hilal at Al-Bayt Stadium on Tuesday to hand the understrength Saudi Pro League leaders their first loss in the western league phase of the Asian Champions League Elite. Wesley Said saw his opener for the home side cancelled out by Al-Hilal captain Salem Al-Dawsari but second half goals from Baghdad Bounedjah and Mohamed Ben Romdhane sealed the points for David Prats' side. "This result is not satisfactory for us," said Al-Dawsari. "There were many mistakes but we will review our mistakes and make up for them in the next match." Simone Inzaghi's Al-Hilal line-up was missing a host of key players with midfielders Ruben Neves and Sergej Milinkovic-Savic absent alongside the injured Gabriel Martinelli and Crysencio Summerville, who was suspended. Al-Shamal struck in the eighth minute through Said, who found the bottom corner with a low strike before Al-Dawsari equalised 24 minutes later when he finished off a counterattack powered by Theo Hernandez's driving run down the left. But Bounedjah's strike three minutes into the second half restored Al-Shamal's lead and Ben Romdhane scored from close range six minutes later to double the home side's advantage. The result leaves Al-Hilal on six points while Al-Shamal move up to five points having drawn their opening two matches. Shabab Al-Ahli continued their winning run with a 2-0 victory over Esteghlal in Dubai to end the Iranian side's unbeaten start to the campaign and climb into second place behind compatriots Al-Ain with both teams on nine points. Mateusao volleyed home Sardar Azmoun's looping centre in the 68th minute to give the hosts the lead and Juan Alvina sealed the result with six minutes left when he shot into the corner. The clubs finishing in the top eight places in the 16-team leagues in west and east Asia progress to the knockout rounds, with the tournament's quarter-finals, semi-finals and final to be played in Saudi Arabia in April and May.

item.content:encoded: El Banco Central de Chile mantuvo el martes su tasa de interés de referencia en 4,5%, en una decisión unánime y en línea con las expectativas del mercado. La Tasa de Política Monetaria (TPM) se mantiene en ese nivel desde diciembre. "Si bien se anticipa que la economía local retomará impulso hacia 2027, no puede descartarse que su debilidad actual sea más persistente que lo previsto", dijo en su comunicado. "En este contexto de incertidumbre mayor que el habitual, el Consejo estará particularmente atento a señales de mayor transmisión y/o persistencia a la inflación de los shocks que se están enfrentando", agregó. El Consejo reiteró que tomará las decisiones necesarias para cumplir con su objetivo de que la inflación proyectada se ubique en 3% en un horizonte de dos años. item.title: Baker Hughes rounds out oilfield services earnings with lower quarterly profit
item.description: Baker Hughes reported a fall in third-quarter profit on Tuesday, as prolonged conflict in the Middle East hit demand for services and equipment in the key oil-producing region.
item.dc:creator: Vallari Srivastava
item.content:encoded: Baker Hughes (BKR.O) reported a fall in third-quarter profit on Tuesday, as prolonged conflict in the Middle East hit demand for services and equipment in the key oil-producing region. Repeated flare-ups in the Middle East conflict, now in its eighth month, have squeezed margins for the oilfield services sector amid delays in project decisions, disrupted activity and concerns over the pace of future spending by customers. Baker Hughes derives nearly 40% of its revenue from the Middle East. It has the biggest exposure to the region among oilfield services rivals SLB (SLB.N) and Halliburton (HAL.N) . The sector is also grappling with muted demand as producers adopt more efficient extraction technologies and ample crude and natural gas supplies curb the need for new drilling. Baker Hughes said revenue from North America fell to $955 million from $980 million a year earlier. In the Middle East and Asia, revenue came in at $1.26 billion, compared with $1.45 billion a year ago. The company expects higher logistics costs and supply chain challenges impacting operations, with Middle East activity expected to be sequentially lower in the fourth quarter. The oilfield services provider now expects annual revenue of $1.99 billion from Chart, an industrial equipment maker it acquired in a $13.6 billion deal in July, compared with its prior forecast of $2.05 billion amid timing of LNG equipment volumes and soft hydrogen demand. Baker Hughes' shares fell more than 1% after the bell. The company left its overall revenue forecast unchanged. CEO Lorenzo Simonelli said it saw meaningful improvement in the Middle East and expects additional opportunity as customers increasingly prioritize maximizing recovery and extending asset life. Melius Research analyst James West said Baker Hughes' outlook "is consistent with our expectations of continued improvement in global oilfield and power markets in 2027." The US oilfield services provider reported net income of $411 million, or 41 cents per share, for the three months ended September 30, compared with $609 million, or 61 cents, a year earlier.

Today's Talking Points: Hyperscalers report Three of the US hyperscalers report third-quarter[USN:L3N46A020 TEXT:" earnings this week"] - Microsoft and Google (Alphabet) after the market close on Wednesday, and Amazon after the bell on Thursday. All eyes are on their outlook for cloud growth, and how quickly the enormous capex spend will turn into profit. The market price action over the last 48 hours suggests investors are in a reasonably bullish mood. These three companies — with nearly $1.7 trillion in combined backlog — plan to spend as much as $600 billion this year. But investors' tolerance for spending that raises the risk of shrinking free cash flow, even more than already priced, does seem to be waning. Look at Meta's results last week — encouraging revenue growth and an upbeat outlook, yet increased spending plans pushed the share price lower. Fed Interest rate futures traders are putting a 90% probability on the Fed concluding its two-day meeting on Wednesday by [USN:L6N46518P TEXT:"leaving rates on hold"]. Bank of America economists stand alone with their call for a hike, but as their colleagues in the BofA rates strategy team point out, it would be unprecedented — since 2009, the Fed has never raised rates with market pricing for a hike this low so close to the meeting. A more interesting debate is whether the Fed should be hiking much at all. Real US interest rates are currently among the highest in the developed world, and a further 75 basis points of tightening is expected over the next year. GDP growth this year is generally expected to settle just above 2% before softening, and there are signs that AI is beginning to trigger sizeable job losses. The flattening yield curve suggests this is one to keep an eye on. Brazil, Day 2 Anyone hoping for a decent rebound in [USN:S0N45R00Y TEXT:"Brazilian financial markets"] after Monday's carnage will be sorely disappointed. Even after plunging 14% in one of its biggest one-day falls on record, the Bovespa stock index still closed in the red on Tuesday. The real, bruised by one of its biggest declines since it was launched in 1994, managed to rebound only 1%. Citi closed its Brazilian risk trades, and Morgan Stanley downgraded Brazil to equal-weight. Yet as historic as the market moves were on Monday — a 10% currency collapse and 14% stock market crash — it's remarkable how little spillover there was into global markets. Yes, LatAm stocks also tumbled on Monday, but MSCI's global emerging markets index on Monday lost only 1% and recouped most of that on Tuesday. Meanwhile, MSCI's emerging Asia index rose 1% on Tuesday. There was virtually no discernible impact on developed markets at all. Brazil is among the world's top 10 economies, but relatively closed. item.title: De capitán a DT de Costa Rica: Bryan Ruiz promete "devolver a la Selección donde merece estar"
item.description: El nuevo director técnico de la selección de fútbol de Costa Rica, Bryan Ruiz, se presentó el martes con la promesa de trabajar para que el equipo centroamericano regrese a la Copa del Mundo después de ausentarse del torneo en 2026 y vuelva a posiciones relevantes que tuvo en el pasado, pues admite que en años recientes ha perdido prestigio.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El nuevo director técnico de la selección de fútbol de Costa Rica, Bryan Ruiz, se presentó el martes con la promesa de trabajar para que el equipo centroamericano regrese a la Copa del Mundo después de ausentarse del torneo en 2026 y vuelva a posiciones relevantes que tuvo en el pasado, pues admite que en años recientes ha perdido prestigio. Ruiz, de 41 años, asume su primera experiencia como entrenador en el nivel mayor del fútbol con el respaldo de dos partidos que dirigió de forma interina en octubre en la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf, además de una exitosa carrera como mediocampista ofensivo en clubes europeos y en la Selección Mayor, con la que participó en tres Mundiales entre 2014 y 2022. "Lo más importante es devolver a la Selección Nacional de Costa Rica al lugar donde merece estar", dijo Ruiz tras ser presentado por Osael Maroto, presidente de la Federación Costarricense de Fútbol de Costa Rica, después de los fracasos del mexicano Miguel 'Piojo' Herrera en 2025 y del argentino Fernando 'Bocha' Batista en 2026. "Sueño con volver a ver el Estadio Nacional a reventar y ver al país celebrar triunfos, con volver a las competencias internacionales y hacer grande a Costa Rica en el área, que lo hemos perdido en los últimos años", añadió Ruiz antes de presentar a su cuerpo técnico, integrado por colaboradores costarricenses, pues aseguró que quiere proyectar en los jugadores actuales el aprecio por la camiseta nacional, que ocupa el puesto 54 en el ranking de la FIFA. "Vamos a pedir compromiso total para dejar a la Selección donde merecemos estar; hay que aceptar que hemos perdido cierto prestigio en la zona", dijo el técnico en probable referencia a la ausencia en el Mundial y a derrotas como las que dejaron a los "ticos" fuera de la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf, a pesar de las dos victorias contra Nicaragua y Haití que provocaron el interés de la Federación en contratar a Ruiz como seleccionador formal con miras al Mundial de 2030. Ruiz tiene licencias de director técnico, pero no había dirigido antes en el nivel mayor, sus únicas experiencias previas fueron dos partidos como interino en las filas del Alajuelense, de donde saltó a la Selección que ahora conduce para el largo plazo. "Soy consciente de que esta oportunidad se me da por más de 100 partidos como capitán y por mi carrera, pero si no me sintiera preparado hubiera dicho que no; me siento preparado y el tiempo irá disminuyendo las dudas que puedan tener", reconoció. El seleccionador debutará en el banquillo en partidos amistosos que calificó de alto nivel: ante la selección de Ecuador el 13 de noviembre en Quito, y cuatro días después ante Argentina en Córdoba. Después, en marzo deberá disputar una llave de ida y vuelta preliminar para acceder a un boleto para la Copa Oro 2027, contra un rival aún por definirse. Para estos partidos, Ruiz probará la mezcla de jugadores de distintos grados de experiencia que desea para lograr "un cambio generacional paulatinamente", con figuras históricas como el portero Keylor Navas, de Pumas de México y exjugador del Real Madrid y del PSG francés. "No sé si jugadores de 39 años van a llegar a un Mundial, pero pueden ayudar muchísimo para que los jóvenes entiendan lo que significa estar en la selección", apuntó.

Here are few details: The move is intended to speed decision-making, improve scale and support broader access to its medicines worldwide, Lilly said Jonsson joined Lilly in 1990 as a sales representative in Sweden and went on to hold leadership positions across Europe, Japan and the United States Yuffa, who joined Lilly in 1996 as a financial analyst, has held senior roles in finance, business development, sales and general management Laura Steele, currently group vice president for US Cardiometabolic Health, will be promoted to president of Lilly USA effective January 1, 2027 Elias Khalil, currently president and general manager of Lilly's Italy Hub, will become group vice president and president of Lilly Europe and Canada Nabil Daoud will remain group vice president and president of Lilly InterContinental, while Karla Alcazar, Huzur Devletsah and Winselow Tucker will continue to lead the company's businesses in Japan, China and India, respectively The leaders of Lilly's six geographic hubs will report to Yuffa under the new global markets structure

item.title: Israelenses batem recorde de participação eleitoral para julgar Netanyahu em tempo de guerra
item.description: Os israelenses compareceram às urnas nesta terça-feira em número recorde para julgar em tempo de guerra o primeiro-ministro, Benjamin Netanyahu, no que alguns descreveram como a eleição de maior importância na história do país.
item.dc:creator: Steven Scheer, Alexander Cornwell
item.content:encoded: Os israelenses compareceram às urnas nesta terça-feira em número recorde para julgar em tempo de guerra o primeiro-ministro, Benjamin Netanyahu, no que alguns descreveram como a eleição de maior importância na história do país. Longas filas se formaram do lado de fora dos locais de votação para a primeira eleição desde os ataques liderados pelo Hamas em 7 de outubro de 2023, enquanto os eleitores lidavam com o trauma do dia mais sangrento de Israel e das guerras que se seguiram em Gaza, no Líbano e no Irã. A Comissão Eleitoral Central informou que a participação eleitoral ficou em 74,3%, a taxa mais alta para esta fase final da votação desde 1988. As urnas fechariam às 22h em Israel (17h no horário de Brasilia). As políticas da coalizão de direita de Netanyahu têm gerado divisões no país e aprofundado o isolamento internacional de Israel. Mas ele se apresenta como o único líder com coragem para enfrentar os inimigos de Israel. NETANYAHU, O SOBREVIVENTE, CONTRA EISENKOT, O GENERAL Netanyahu, o líder mais longevo de Israel, com 19 anos no cargo, é um sobrevivente político sem igual, e sua política nacionalista está cada vez mais arraigada. O sistema fragmentado de Israel dificulta que um conjunto de oponentes consiga derrubar sua coalizão de partidos de direita, extrema-direita e ultraortodoxos. Seu principal rival, Gadi Eisenkot, ex-chefe do Estado-Maior das Forças Armadas e defensor de uma linha dura em questões de segurança, pretende destituí-lo com o apoio de partidos de direita e de centro, bem como do que resta de uma esquerda cada vez mais marginalizada. As pesquisas de opinião mostram uma disputa acirrada, sem garantir a nenhum dos dois um caminho fácil para o poder. Os analistas hesitaram em prever qual seria o impacto que a alta participação eleitoral poderia ter no resultado. Um aumento nos votos de israelenses de ascendência palestina poderia limitar os ganhos da coalizão de direita de Netanyahu e tornar mais provável que qualquer governo formado para destituí-lo precisasse do apoio de partidos árabes — uma perspectiva controversa entre os líderes dos partidos judeus. Netanyahu exortou seus apoiadores a comparecerem às urnas para contrabalançar a alta participação entre seus oponentes da esquerda e dos árabes israelenses. “Todos vocês precisam ir em massa às urnas”, disse ele. “Este é um momento decisivo.” Osama Saadi, político palestino e líder da Lista Conjunta, uma chapa unificada que reúne vários partidos de maioria árabe, disse que houve uma participação “histórica” dos eleitores palestinos com cidadania israelense nas eleições. Os cidadãos palestinos de Israel tiveram uma taxa de comparecimento às urnas de cerca de 69%, enquanto a participação árabe total nas últimas eleições foi de aproximadamente 56%, disse Saadi. “Acho que essas eleições são as mais importantes de todas as que já presenciei”, disse Ruth Epstein, uma eleitora de 81 anos de longa data da esquerda em Ramat Gan, perto de Tel Aviv, que votou nos Democratas, da oposição. Netanyahu fez campanha com o apoio do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, seu aliado na guerra contra o Irã, que afirmou que eles deveriam “concluir o trabalho”. Se nem Netanyahu nem Eisenkot conseguirem formar uma coalizão de governo no Parlamento de 120 cadeiras, Netanyahu poderá permanecer como interino até que seja realizada outra eleição. Seus oponentes conseguiram tirar-lhe o cargo de primeiro-ministro apenas uma vez desde 2009, e isso exigiu quatro eleições sem resultado decisivo em dois anos. Dezoito meses depois, ele estava de volta. EISENKOT VÊ UM “NOVO ESPÍRITO” Para muitos dos oponentes de Netanyahu, a eleição gira em torno da responsabilização pelas falhas de segurança de 7 de outubro, o dia mais sangrento de Israel. Grupos da oposição prometeram realizar uma investigação nacional, à qual o governo de Netanyahu tem se oposto. “Estou convencido de que, até o final do dia de hoje, veremos uma mudança — um novo espírito para o Estado de Israel — que servirá como uma correção para os últimos três anos e para aquele dia terrível”, disse Eisenkot durante uma visita ao kibutz Nir Oz, no sul de Israel, alvo dos ataques de 7 de outubro. Ele foi às urnas com Gadi Mozes, uma das 251 pessoas sequestradas pelo Hamas e levadas para Gaza durante o ataque que matou 1.200 pessoas. Eisenkot afirma que a resposta de Israel — uma guerra que, segundo as autoridades de saúde, matou mais de 74 mil palestinos — foi um fracasso, pois o Hamas continua no poder. Ele reiterou seu compromisso de desmantelar ou destruir o poder militar e governamental do Hamas em Gaza dentro de 18 meses após a formação do governo. Itamar Ben-Gvir, líder de um partido de extrema-direita na coalizão de Netanyahu, votou no assentamento de Kiryat Arba, na Cisjordânia ocupada, na manhã desta terça-feira. Ele previu que Netanyahu voltaria como primeiro-ministro e que seu próprio partido serviria como âncora de direita do governo. PARTICIPAÇÃO DOS ÁRABES PODE SER FUNDAMENTAL Ahmed Tibi, candidato de um partido árabe, afirmou que uma participação recorde da minoria árabe de Israel “abriria caminho para um governo alternativo e mudaria a grave realidade”. Eisenkot descartou uma aliança com partidos árabes, embora, em alguns cenários, ele pudesse contar com eles para sustentar um governo minoritário que mantenha Netanyahu fora do poder. Netanyahu tem repetidamente descrito os árabes israelenses, que representam um quinto da população, como uma ameaça, com um discurso que, segundo seus oponentes, beira o racismo. Ele postou uma imagem no X nesta terça-feira mostrando uma fila de mulheres árabes, usando niqabs ou com expressões de raiva, supostamente em uma seção eleitoral. De acordo com o site de verificação da OpenAI, a imagem foi criada usando suas ferramentas de IA. Carros com a bandeira do partido Likud, de Netanyahu, percorreram as ruas de Jerusalém com alto-falantes tocando a chamada islâmica para a oração e exortando: “Saiam de suas casas agora! Os árabes estão votando!” Como quase todos os líderes de partidos judeus em Israel, Eisenkot se opõe à solução de dois Estados, que outrora serviu de base para décadas de negociações de paz com os palestinos. Mas ele tem criticado a violência dos colonos judeus contra os palestinos na Cisjordânia ocupada por Israel, que aumentou desde 2023 e prejudicou as relações de Israel com os países ocidentais. Além disso, ele se opõe aos parceiros de coalizão de extrem-direita de Netanyahu.

item.title: Wall Street fecha em alta com retorno do ímpeto do setor de IA
item.description: Uma alta no setor de tecnologia impulsionada pela IA levou as ações nos EUA a fecharem em alta nesta terça-feira, à medida que a temporada de divulgação de resultados do terceiro trimestre ganhava força, enquanto o Federal Reserve se reunia para sua penúltima reunião do ano.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Shashwat Chauhan
item.content:encoded: Uma alta no setor de tecnologia impulsionada pela IA levou as ações nos EUA a fecharem em alta nesta terça-feira, à medida que a temporada de divulgação de resultados do terceiro trimestre ganhava força, enquanto o Federal Reserve se reunia para sua penúltima reunião do ano. O Nasdaq, com forte presença de empresas de tecnologia, liderou os ganhos. O entusiasmo em torno dos detalhes da iminente oferta pública inicial (IPO) da Anthropic ajudou a impulsionar as ações de empresas de chips (.SOX) pela terceira sessão consecutiva. Preocupações crescentes com a viabilidade dos gastos financiados por dívida, em meio ao aumento dos custos de empréstimos, pesaram sobre o setor de IA neste mês. O índice Philadelphia SE Semiconductor, embora esteja mais de 20% abaixo de sua máxima histórica de fechamento registrada em 22 de junho, apresentou desempenho superior ao do mercado em geral, com alta de 62,1% em comparação com o avanço de 12,8% do S&P 500 no acumulado do ano. Para financiar sua expansão em IA, a Meta (META.O) aumentou sua maior captação de recursos de capital de todos os tempos para US$97,5 bilhões, levando as ações da controladora do Facebook a uma queda. “(As notícias sobre a Anthropic) parecem estar proporcionando uma pequena recuperação de alívio às ações do setor de IA, particularmente às de semicondutores”, disse Chuck Carlson, presidente-executivo da Horizon Investment Services em Hammond, Indiana, referindo-se às ações de fabricantes de chips. “Essas ações sofreram forte queda nas últimas semanas e provavelmente já estavam prestes a se recuperar.” Dados econômicos mostraram um aumento nos novos pedidos de computadores e equipamentos periféricos, reforçando a ideia de fortes gastos relacionados à IA. O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) teve variação positiva de 0,03%, para 52.377,57 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) subiu 0,60%, para 7.722,60 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) avançou 1,18%, para 26.477,81 pontos. Dos 11 principais setores do S&P 500, o de tecnologia liderou os ganhos, enquanto as ações do setor de energia sofreram a maior queda percentual, afetadas pela queda nos preços do petróleo bruto , à medida que a atenção se voltou para as negociações de paz no Oriente Médio. Quase metade das empresas do S&P 500 já divulgou seus resultados do terceiro trimestre. Dessas, 83% apresentaram resultados melhores do que o esperado, de acordo com os dados mais recentes disponíveis da LSEG. A Boeing (BA.N) despencou 10,7% após registrar um prejuízo no terceiro trimestre maior do que o esperado, enquanto a empresa de gestão hídrica Xylem (XYL.N) desabou 14,2% após revisar para baixo suas previsões para o ano inteiro. A UPS (UPS.N) subiu 5,8% depois que a empresa de entrega de encomendas elevou suas previsões anuais de receita e lucro. O resultado trimestral abaixo do esperado da Sherwin-Williams (SHW.N) fez com que as ações caíssem 2,7%, pesando sobre o Dow. A Royal Caribbean (RCL.N) subiu 5,5% depois que a operadora de cruzeiros elevou sua previsão de lucro para o ano inteiro. Os resultados da Microsoft (MSFT.O) e da Alphabet (GOOGL.O) são esperados para quarta-feira, enquanto a Amazon.com deve divulgar seus resultados na quinta-feira. O Fed se reuniu na terça-feira para sua reunião de dois dias de política monetária de outubro, que, segundo amplas expectativas, deve culminar na decisão de manter a meta da taxa básica na faixa de 3,75% a 4%, adiando seu segundo aumento de juros do ano para a reunião final em dezembro, de acordo com a ferramenta FedWatch da CME. “Parece haver mais confiança de que o Fed não tomará nenhuma medida nesta reunião, em parte porque temos uma eleição na terça-feira”, acrescentou Carlson. “Provavelmente há pelo menos algum alívio pelo fato de que a situação das taxas não vai atrapalhar uma recuperação do mercado.”

item.title: Mujer que confrontó saqueadores es identificada erróneamente como dueña de tienda
item.description: Una mujer que confrontó a personas enmascaradas en la entrada de una tienda en París, Francia, fue erróneamente identificada en redes sociales como una activista que intentó impedir que refugiados a los que ella misma apoya saquearan su negocio.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Una mujer que confrontó a personas enmascaradas en la entrada de una tienda en París, Francia, fue erróneamente identificada en redes sociales como una activista que intentó impedir que refugiados a los que ella misma apoya saquearan su negocio. Ejemplos en Facebook comparten las imágenes de la mujer con los brazos extendidos en una entrada del negocio alrededor de personas con el rostro cubierto. Las publicaciones no mencionan el nombre de la mujer, pero dicen que es reconocida por “defender la inmigración de personas del norte de África”, integrante de un partido de izquierda en Francia y dueña de una boutique que intentó proteger su negocio. Añaden que esta persona se identificó, mostró su apoyo a los migrantes y que un grupo de personas la empujó, derribó y la pisoteó. Reuters no ha identificado a la mujer ni a las personas enmascaradas. Sin embargo, la mujer se encuentra en la entrada de una sucursal de Franprix, una cadena de tiendas de conveniencia propiedad de un consorcio. El periodista Frederic Munsch publicó el video de la mujer en Instagram el 17 de octubre. En el clip, la mujer llega a la puerta de la tienda gritando “¡Alto!”, “¿Por qué están haciendo esto?” y “¡De eso no se trata la causa!”, mientras individuos enmascarados la empujan para entrar en el establecimiento y otros salen con algunos productos. El video posteriormente muestra una ventana rota y a una persona con una playera con el logotipo de Franprix. La mujer no se presenta por su nombre ni dice ser activista a favor de los migrantes. Una persona con el rostro cubierto aparta a la mujer de la entrada y, segundos después, parece alejarse. Las imágenes no registran que ella haya sido derribada y pisoteada. Reuters geolocalizó la tienda en París . Establecimientos cercanos coinciden con una captura de Apple Maps . Franprix es una cadena de tiendas de conveniencia y forma parte del grupo de supermercados francés Plesio , anteriormente Casino, propiedad del multimillonario checo [USN:S8N3RE0BD TEXT:"Daniel Kretinsky"]. Según la página web de Plesio, existen más de mil tiendas Franprix en Francia. El departamento de comunicaciones de Plesio dijo a Reuters en un correo electrónico que la tienda en el video es propiedad de la empresa y es gestionada por ellos mismos. Agregó que la mujer en el video no es empleada. Munsch dijo a Reuters en un correo electrónico que grabó el video el 17 de octubre, aproximadamente a las 17:30, hora local y que no conocía personalmente a la mujer, aunque creía que estaba “de paso”. [USN:S8N42Q0F9 TEXT:"Ese día"] hubo protestas por el costo de vida en la cercana Plaza de la República y otras ciudades francesas, durante las cuales ocurrieron saqueos. VEREDICTO Engañoso. Las imágenes muestran a una mujer en la entrada de una tienda de la cadena Franprix. La empresa propietaria dijo que la mujer no es empleada. Las publicaciones no ofrecen ninguna prueba sobre la identidad de la mujer ni las declaraciones que le atribuyen. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: New-look Heat face Hawks still in search of first victory
item.description: After opening the season with so much promise, the Miami Heat will look to end a four-game losing skid when they visit the Atlanta Hawks on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: After opening the season with so much promise, the Miami Heat will look to end a four-game losing skid when they visit the Atlanta Hawks on Wednesday. While there figured to be an adjustment period with the addition of Giannis Antetokounmpo, nobody could have expected this. A week after the two-time MVP's debut for Miami, the Heat are still looking for a victory. Miami is off to its first 0-4 start since the 2007-08 season, when it finished 15-67. Antetokounmpo had his first triple-double with the Heat in a 113-109 home loss to the Dallas Mavericks on Monday. The 10-time All-Star finished with 29 points, 14 rebounds and 11 assists, but Miami shot 9 of 25 (36%) from the field in the fourth quarter and missed 11 of their 25 free throws overall. "This is not the start anybody wanted, but it has happened," Heat coach Erik Spoelstra said. "So we have to address what's in front of us, and we need to continue to get more consistent with our game." Davion Mitchell scored 21 points in the loss to Dallas, while Bam Adebayo had eight points on 3-of-10 shooting. Adebayo is averaging 11.8 points and has made just three of 18 3-point attempts. Miami's offensive rating of 105.3 is 27th in the league entering Tuesday's play. Adebayo said he is being made the "scapegoat" for Miami's slow start, but Antetokounmpo said there is plenty of blame to go around. "I think it's not just Bam. It's everybody," Antetokounmpo said. "We're trying to figure out where we fit in and what we've got to do. We try to not step on toes. I do it myself at times. I find myself just floating around and trying to see how to help the team." The Heat won three of their four meetings last season against the Hawks. Atlanta enters the game at 2-2 following consecutive losses to the Houston Rockets, including a 120-110 road defeat on Monday. Atlanta struggled to contain Houston's interior attack in Monday's loss. The Rockets scored 64 points in the paint, shot 53.1 percent from the field and outrebounded the Hawks 52-35. Jalen Johnson scored 21 points and CJ McCollum added 20, but the Hawks went 3 of 16 from 3-point range in the second half as the Rockets used a 22-2 run midway through the fourth quarter to secure the win. "When we play the way that we need to play, we're very competitive," Hawks coach Quin Snyder said. "But when we don't change side to side, we don't run, we don't pass the ball, we're just not as good a team." Hawks center Onyeka Okongwu had 11 points, nine rebounds, one assist, two steals, one block and one 3-pointer against the Rockets. Atlanta will need its perimeter defenders to disrupt Miami before Antetokounmpo gets downhill. Dyson Daniels is averaging 3.5 steals and 2.5 offensive rebounds, giving the Hawks extra possessions. Snyder has emphasized that Daniels can share demanding defensive assignments with Nickeil Alexander-Walker and Luguentz Dort. "You can't put him on everybody," Snyder said of Daniels. "And, you know, those matchup questions, you've got other guys in Nickeil, too, that can guard the ball." --Field Level Media

item.title: Robinhood profit misses estimates as crypto trading slows
item.description: Robinhood Markets missed Wall Street estimates for third-quarter profit on Tuesday, as slower cryptocurrency trading and higher expenses overshadowed strong activity in options and prediction markets.
item.dc:creator: Prakhar Srivastava, Rishab Shaju
item.content:encoded: Robinhood Markets (HOOD.O) missed Wall Street estimates for third-quarter profit on Tuesday, as slower cryptocurrency trading and higher expenses overshadowed strong activity in options and prediction markets. Shares of the Menlo Park, California-based company fell 7% in after-hours trading. The trading platform's transaction-based revenue from cryptocurrencies fell 55% to $120 million from a year earlier. Crypto markets have come under pressure this year amid heightened volatility and persistent outflows, as inflationary pressures and higher interest rates make bonds and other traditional investments more attractive than speculative assets. Bitcoin, the world's largest cryptocurrency, has fallen as much as 8% year to date as geopolitical tensions and rising oil prices add to market uncertainty. OPTIONS, EVENT CONTRACTS OFFSET CRYPTO SLUMP Robinhood's overall transaction-based revenue rose about 19% to $867 million, driven by a more than sixfold increase in event-contracts revenue and a 31% jump in options revenue. However, revenue growth lagged the increase in trading contracts, suggesting that growth was becoming more concentrated in a few key areas, said Bill Birmingham, research head at REX Financial. "Prediction markets are becoming a second outlet for the same core active traders rather than a funnel for new customers," Birmingham said, adding that some of the volume may reflect a shift from existing trading activity rather than incremental business. Robinhood CFO Shiv Verma, however, emphasized that prediction markets was an important growth driver for the company. "Prediction markets is almost a $500-million-a-year business already, and so growing incredibly nicely, and it's less than two years old because it came out at the start of the 2024 election," Verma told journalists over a call. He said both sports and non-sports event contracts were growing strongly, with non-sports contracts accounting for a larger share of overall trading volume. The company's operating expenses rose 16% to $739 million for the three months ended September 30, driven by higher credit-loss provisions, spending on new businesses such as Trump Accounts and Rothera, and increased marketing. Robinhood posted a profit of 51 cents per share, missing analysts' expectations of a per-share profit of 55 cents, according to estimates compiled by LSEG.

item.title: Ibovespa tem queda modesta em dia de acomodação após tombo; incertezas persistem
item.description: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta terça-feira, em pregão de acomodação na bolsa paulista após fortes perdas na véspera com o desfecho da eleição presidencial no país, enquanto persistem incertezas sobre o próximo mandato do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta terça-feira, em pregão de acomodação na bolsa paulista após fortes perdas na véspera com o desfecho da eleição presidencial no país, enquanto persistem incertezas sobre o próximo mandato do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) caiu 0,51%, a 175.710,05 pontos, mas chegou a 178.526,08 pontos na máxima do dia. Na mínima, marcou 175.130,23 pontos. O volume financeiro no pregão somou R$72,23 bilhões. Na segunda-feira, o Ibovespa [USN:S0N450028 TEXT:"caiu"] quase 14%, na maior queda desde 2020, após a reeleição de Lula contrariar expectativas no mercado de vitória do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e uma possível agenda mais favorável a um ajuste fiscal. Levantamento da Elos Ayta apurou que as empresas listadas na B3 perderam um valor de mercado consolidado de R$734 bilhões na véspera. Agentes financeiros atribuíram o movimento de segunda-feira a desmonte de posições que apostavam na vitória de Flávio, não necessariamente a fundamentos, mas apontaram aumento de incertezas sobre as perspectivas fiscais do país. Em Brasília, o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan, disse nesta terça-feira mais cedo que reafirmou a Lula a necessidade de dar uma [USN:L2N46D0LK TEXT:"sinalização"] propositiva ao mercado e que o governo já tem medidas prontas para apresentação, incluindo a que permite a busca do centro da meta fiscal. A declaração não foi suficiente para uma melhora mais sólida, com investidores preferindo esperar para ver os planos para o quarto mandato de Lula. De acordo com o analista Matheus Villela, da gestora de patrimônio Aware Investments, a performance do Ibovespa nesta sessão mostra que o ambiente segue volátil e marcado por incertezas. "O foco dos investidores agora se desloca da eleição para a condução da política econômica. O mercado aguarda, sobretudo, a definição do nome para o Ministério da Fazenda e algum sinal concreto do governo de compromisso com o equilíbrio das contas públicas", afirmou. Na visão de Villela, enquanto essa sinalização não vier, a tendência é que a volatilidade permaneça elevada, com os preços bastante sensíveis a cada notícia vinda de Brasília. DESTAQUES VALE ON (VALE3.SA) recuou 2,14%, em meio ao declínio dos futuros do minério de ferro na China, onde o contrato mais negociado na Bolsa de Mercadorias de Dalian fechou o pregão diurno com queda de 0,9%. Também no radar está o balanço da mineradora do terceiro trimestre, previsto para quinta-feira, após o fechamento do mercado. PETROBRAS PN caiu 2,02%, com a fraqueza do petróleo no exterior também no radar. O barril do Brent [USN:L6N46D1H4 TEXT:"fechou"] em queda de 1,8%, a US$113,88. O Goldman Sachs prevê que a Petrobras deverá manter os [USN:L6N46D0VL TEXT:"preços do diesel"] vendido a distribuidoras inalterados até o fim do ano, após o governo brasileiro ter decidido prorrogar por mais 30 dias os subsídios ao combustível. BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) fechou em queda de 0,52%, sem conseguir sustentar o sinal positivo que apresentou em parte da sessão, chegando a uma alta de 4,8% no melhor momento. Na véspera, o papel encerrou o dia com um tombo de mais de 29%. BRADESCO PN terminou com decréscimo de 1,38%, ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN perdeu 1,22 % e SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT , que divulga balanço na quarta-feira, caiu 1,63%. BTG PACTUAL UNIT subiu 0,42%. O Citi rebaixou as ações do BB para venda e do Bradesco para neutra, enquanto manteve Itaú e BTG com recomendação de compra. B3 ON (B3SA3.SA) avançou 2,19%, em sessão de ajustes, embora tenha arrefecido ante a máxima do dia (+4,71%). Na véspera, a ação fechou com um tombo superior a 36,28%, após afundar quase 50% no pior momento. Em Nova York, XP (XP.O) subiu 1,62%, experimentando uma trégua após desabar mais de 48% na segunda-feira. Analistas do Citi cortaram a recomendação para ambos os papéis para "neutra", avaliando que juros mais altos e a incerteza fiscal devem continuar pressionando o apetite por risco, as entradas líquidas de recursos, a atividade de negociação e as emissões no mercado de capitais. "Embora a qualidade dos negócios permaneça sólida, vemos um ambiente operacional menos favorável." MAGAZINE LUIZA ON (MGLU3.SA) saltou 8,49%, em dia de correção, após afundar mais de 58% na segunda-feira. TENDA ON (TEND3.SA) subiu 10,2%, também com ajustes, assim como DIRECIONAL ON (DIRR3.SA) , que fechou com elevação de 5,35%, endossadas ainda por relatório do JPMorgan, que elevou a recomendação de ambos os papéis para "overweight". CURY ON (CURY3.SA) , que também teve upgrade, avançou 3,55%. Na contramão, MRV&CO ON (MRVE3.SA) recuou 5,71%, CYRELA ON (CYRE3.SA) caiu 3,16% e EZTEC ON (EZTC3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, perdeu 6,25%. O JPMorgan manteve MRV&Co com recomendação neutra, mesma classificação que agora estabeleceu para Cyrela e Eztec, que eram "overweight". GERDAU PN (GGBR4.SA) caiu 2,75%, em pregão negativo no setor siderúrgico, com investidores também analisando o [USN:S0N46906J TEXT:"balanço"] da companhia no terceiro trimestre, que mostrou lucro líquido ajustado de R$1,52 bilhão, alta de 39,7% ano a ano. O vice-presidente financeiro do grupo, Rafael Japur, disse nesta terça-feira que a principal operação da Gerdau, a América do Norte, deve ter [USN:L2N46D0LH TEXT:"volumes de venda menores"] no quarto trimestre, mas margem de lucro operacional estável na comparação trimestral. BRASKEM PNA , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, disparou 16,35%, também recuperando-se de fortes perdas na véspera. No sábado, a petroquímica informou que, após diversas reuniões com seus principais acionistas e investidores, nenhuma das propostas relacionadas ao plano de recuperação extrajudicial foi aceita e as partes ainda não chegaram a um acordo quanto aos termos de uma reestruturação de dívidas da ordem de US$10,9 bilhões da petroquímica. No entanto, afirmou que as negociações foram [USN:L6N46A08T TEXT:"prorrogadas"] até 30 de outubro.

item.title: Logitech beats profit forecast as sales of gaming, conferencing products rise
item.description: Logitech International on Tuesday reported a better-than-expected profit for the second quarter, with the computer mouse and keyboard maker seeing higher demand for its gaming and video conferencing devices.
item.dc:creator: John Revill
item.content:encoded: Logitech International (LOGN.S) on Tuesday reported a better-than-expected profit for the second quarter, with the computer mouse and keyboard maker seeing higher demand for its gaming and video conferencing devices. The Swiss-U.S. company reported non-GAAP operating income of $231 million for the three months to the end of September, beating forecasts for $204 million in a consensus gathered by Visible Alpha and the company's own guidance for $185 million to $210 million. Sales rose 3% to $1.22 billion, in line with analyst forecasts and towards the upper end of the company's own outlook of $1.19 billion to $1.22 billion. CEO Hanneke Faber said Logitech had come through a difficult period marked by tight component sourcing, higher costs and the conflict in the Middle East. "Even as global PC shipments declined by 20% in the quarter, our pointing devices and keyboards grew by mid single digits, demonstrating our growth opportunity comes from the large installed PC base," she told analysts on a call. Innovation, including products like matcha and latte-coloured mice, had helped the company grow sales in that category, while 15 new products in the gaming category boosted sales there. Sales of video collaboration equipment rose 12% as business customers refreshed their workplaces after encouraging staff back to the office. "Video collaboration demand is strong and we expect it to continue to be strong," Faber said. "It's not discretionary. You need to refresh those rooms, you need expanded office space if you are going to ask people to come back to work." Faber said there was strong demand from healthcare and government customers. Logitech also said it had suffered a lower-than-expected impact from the forced closure at a factory of one of its semiconductor suppliers at the end of June, which it originally expected to cost it up to $200 million in lost sales in the next quarter. After getting chips from other suppliers, the company said it now expects the impact to be $70 million to $80 million. Logitech said its sales would be in the range of $1.36 billion to $1.43 billion for the three months to the end of December. It also expects non-GAAP operating income of $220 million to $255 million down from $312 million a year earlier, due to higher component and transport costs, as well as the lost sales caused by the factory shutdown.

item.title: Visa results beat estimates as resilient customers keep up spending
item.description: Visa beat expectations for fourth-quarter results on Tuesday as customers continued swiping their cards to pay for travel, shopping and dining out despite macroeconomic uncertainty.
item.dc:creator: Arasu Basil, Atharva Singh
item.content:encoded: Visa (V.N) beat expectations for fourth-quarter results on Tuesday as customers continued swiping their cards to pay for travel, shopping and dining out despite macroeconomic uncertainty.
